set.body: Goal: use one canonical storage representation for aesthetic mappings while preserving the typed public API. Current evidence: AesSpec[Row] now carries fourteen optional fields; env and fromEnv convert field by field; bindScale and inherit round-trip through both forms; LayerPlan and StatPlan each carry both mapping and env. Acceptance: choose one storage model based on type safety, iteration needs, and public ergonomics rather than preselecting the map; preserve typed aesthetic accessors and deterministic scale iteration; remove env and fromEnv round-trips and duplicate compiler-plan fields; keep TrainedPlot behavior and diagnostics unchanged; JVM and Scala.js tests pass. Complete this before heterogeneous-layer packing so the existential design does not duplicate both representations.
